comment: The field of a head-to-head venue: the grid, the three field cars of each heat (line and pace draws, the redraw of a heat whose field fails alone), the predicates a venue must pass and the field-alone run. The draw blocks (grid, field, tiers, streams, redraw) decide the world-file additions; the remaining blocks are the predicates' and the measurements' own numbers.

redraw.comment: A heat whose field fails the field-alone run is drawn again: its three lines and three paces, from the line and pace streams extended by the attempt index 1 to attempts_max (index 0 is the stream without the extension). The index of each heat is written to truth.head_to_head under attempts_key.
